posts.author: JakeMSG
posts.body:
Coming off of the feet of "Webp-PNG Batch Converter (wpBC)" (which you can find
[here]
), I decided to make a similar utility, this time for conversion between OGG and MP3 files. Once again, since the MP3 format is a more compressed format more often used than the OGG format (which is found in RPG Maker games).
Like before, these are simply batch file "wrappers" that run the actual executable(s) needed for the conversion, and once again, you can even add them to the "Send To" right-click context menu, if you wish, for an even easier usage (check the instructions inside for more info on how to do it).
Also works well with my MV/MZ plugin: "Webp, MP3, and Subfolders In MV Commands", which you can get
[here]
.
Download
Mega

posts.author: ZimXero
posts.body: Not sure about the premise that MP3 is better than OGG, but one thing I hate about OGG is that a folder with more than 50 of them takes for ever to load and reload after each modification.  This delay has probably stolen a dozen hours of total production time from me when added up.

posts.author: JakeMSG
posts.body:
ZimXero said:
Not sure about the premise that MP3 is better than OGG, but one thing I hate about OGG is that a folder with more than 50 of them takes for ever to load and reload after each modification.  This delay has probably stolen a dozen hours of total production time from me when added up.
Click to expand...
Ah, for that, I've got an easier fix for you. That's most likely due to how Windows automatically "optimizes" how a folder should be viewed based on the files inside. Here's how to fix it:
======== 1. Right-click the folder (or inside the folder), go to Properties
======== 2. Go to Customize, the on the option "Optimize this folder to", change it to "General items"
==== You can also make this change "Also apply this template to all subfolders"
======== 3. Click "Apply"
Now even such folders will load as normal, instead of showing you info like Artist names or other stuff (that made it always load a fkton lot slower).
